title: 面試
description: 工作面試中的常用問答

sentences.en: Tell me about yourself.
sentences.zh: 請介紹一下你自己。

sentences.en: Why are you interested in this position?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼對這個職位感興趣？

sentences.en: What are your greatest strengths?
sentences.zh: 你最大的優勢是什麼？

sentences.en: What do you consider your weaknesses?
sentences.zh: 你認為自己的弱點是什麼？

sentences.en: Why did you leave your previous job?
sentences.zh: 你為什麼離開上一份工作？

sentences.en: Where do you see yourself in five years?
sentences.zh: 你五年後想達到什麼目標？

sentences.en: What are your salary expectations?
sentences.zh: 你的期望薪資是多少？

sentences.en: Why should we hire you?
sentences.zh: 我們為什麼應該錄用你？

sentences.en: Can you describe a challenging situation you've faced at work?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一個你在工作中面臨的挑戰嗎？

sentences.en: How do you handle pressure and tight deadlines?
sentences.zh: 你如何應對壓力和緊迫的截止日期？

sentences.en: Do you have any questions for us?
sentences.zh: 你有什麼問題想問我們嗎？

sentences.en: I'm a quick learner and adapt easily to new environments.
sentences.zh: 我學習能力強，能快速適應新環境。

sentences.en: I have five years of experience in this field.
sentences.zh: 我在這個領域有五年的經驗。

sentences.en: What does a typical day look like in this role?
sentences.zh: 這個職位的日常工作是什麼樣的？

sentences.en: I'm passionate about solving complex problems.
sentences.zh: 我熱衷於解決複雜的問題。

sentences.en: How would your former colleagues describe you?
sentences.zh: 你以前的同事會怎麼形容你？

sentences.en: I work well both independently and as part of a team.
sentences.zh: 我能獨立工作，也能很好地融入團隊。

sentences.en: What's the company culture like here?
sentences.zh: 這裡的公司文化是什麼樣的？

sentences.en: I'm looking for a role where I can grow professionally.
sentences.zh: 我在尋找一個能讓我專業成長的職位。

sentences.en: When would you like me to start?
sentences.zh: 你希望我什麼時候開始上班？

sentences.en: I'm comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
sentences.zh: 我能適應快節奏的工作環境。

sentences.en: Could you tell me more about the team I'd be working with?
sentences.zh: 能告訴我更多關於我將合作的團隊嗎？

sentences.en: I believe my skills are a great match for this position.
sentences.zh: 我相信我的技能非常適合這個職位。

sentences.en: What opportunities are there for professional development?
sentences.zh: 有什麼專業發展的機會？

sentences.en: I'm available to start immediately.
sentences.zh: 我可以立即上班。

sentences.en: How is performance evaluated in this role?
sentences.zh: 這個職位的績效如何評估？

sentences.en: I thrive in collaborative work environments.
sentences.zh: 我在合作的工作環境中表現出色。

sentences.en: Thank you for taking the time to interview me.
sentences.zh: 感謝你花時間面試我。

sentences.en: I'd love the opportunity to contribute to your team.
sentences.zh: 我很希望有機會為你們的團隊做出貢獻。

sentences.en: Is there anything else you'd like to know about my background?
sentences.zh: 關於我的背景，還有什麼想了解的嗎？
